caption_L1: Here a bar chart is called Average cigarette prices in Canada from 2006 to 2014 , by region (in Canadian dollars). The y-axis measures Apr 17, 2009 as linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 100 while the x-axis shows region of Canada along categorical scale starting with Alberta and ending with Yukon Territory.
caption_L2L3: Each region has a relatively similar number of cigarette prices to each other, the highest average price coming from the Northwest territories and the least coming from Quebec. The Northwest territories is the only region where the average price is more than 100.
